title: Microsoft Outlook Outage: What Happened and How to Keep Email Running When M365 Goes Down
content_md: The latest Microsoft Outlook outage shows that cloud email downtime is more than an IT inconvenience. It can quickly become a business-continuity issue. Microsoft has pinpointed the underlying issue to a problem in a fundamental authentication configuration impacting several Microsoft 365 services, and it is presently evaluating a solution strategy. Article Link: Microsoft Outlook Outage: What Happened and What to Do
exclude_reason: General IT outage explainer/advisory piece, not a security event. No CVEs, no attack details, focused on business continuity advice rather than security implications.
